theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) :=
    Set.Finite.subset
      ((Set.finite_Icc B T).prod ((Set.finite_Icc B T).prod ((Set.finite_Icc B T).prod (Set.finite_Icc B T))))
      (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun n => ⟨hB n, hB (n + 1), hB (n + 2), hB (n + 3)⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! hc
    refine absurd (Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun a b hab => ?_) (Set.not_infinite.mpr hfin)
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy a b with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact absurd hab (hc a b hlt)
    · exact heq
    · exact absurd hab.symm (hc b a hgt)
  simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  have hdet : ∀ p q : ℕ, 4 ≤ p → 4 ≤ q → u (p - 1) = u (q - 1) → u (p - 2) = u (q - 2) →
      u (p - 3) = u (q - 3) → u (p - 4) = u (q - 4) → u p = u q := by
    intro p q hp hq a b c d
    have e := (hu q hq).1
    rw [← a, ← b, ← c, ← d] at e
    exact Int.cast_inj.1 ((hu p hp).1.trans e.symm)
  have H : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ m ih =>
      match m, ih with
      | 0, _ => exact h.1
      | 1, _ => exact h.2.1
      | 2, _ => exact h.2.2.1
      | 3, _ => exact h.2.2.2
      | k + 4, ih =>
        exact hdet (i + (k + 4)) (j + (k + 4)) (by omega) (by omega)
          (ih (k + 3) (by omega)) (ih (k + 2) (by omega)) (ih (k + 1) (by omega)) (ih k (by omega))
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 := H (n - i)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hn, show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) from by omega] at h1
  exact h1.symm
